text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock B and C after large gains felt rewarding, but I should avoid trimming without a plan for how much of each position to keep invested.","Buying more of every stock in Period 6 while the account was declining increased my exposure; before adding, I should check my cash, concentration, and overall risk.","My account recovered in Period 10, but I should not treat one positive month as proof of a trend; with my long-term approach, I should make deliberate decisions rather than react to short-term swings."]}
